rules.note: Mass in Honour of St Joseph

info.adoration: Adoration Room: Mon-Fri 7.00am to 9.00pm, Sat 9.30am to 7.00pm, Sun 8.00am to 7.00pm, public holidays 8.00am to 4.00pm. Holy Hour: first Friday 8.00pm in the Main Church. Holy Hour for Vocations: third Thursday 8.00pm in the Chapel of St Jo
info.confession: 15 minutes before all weekend Masses, in the Reconciliation Rooms in the Church.
devotions: Garden Rosary: first Saturday after the 5.30pm Sunset Mass
Grotto Rosary: every 13th of the month after the 6.30pm Mass (weekdays only)

events.title: All Saints Day Fair
events.text: At the Parish Community Hall on 31 Oct and 1 Nov; children and youth from the catechetical sessions bring the stories of the saints to life through creative displays. Admission is open to all.

events.title: Formed to Flourish
events.text: A casual, welcoming space for young adults in their 20s and 30s to meet their Catholic community, make new friends and share in fellowship.

events.title: Scripture Series: 1st & 2nd Letters of St Peter
Treasure #18 Retreat for Young Working Adults
events.text: Stay-in Catholic Encounter Retreat for young working adults aged 21-35, from Fri 6 to Mon 9 Nov.

events.title: Bible in the City
events.text: An honest conversation about what it means to be a Catholic man today, and the men God is calling us to become.

events.title: Emmanuel
events.text: A time of reflection for those approaching retirement or already in their golden years, on navigating this stage of life with confidence and clarity.

events.title: Welcoming New Parishioners
events.text: On 14 and 15 November, a casual space to meet fellow parishioners, make new friends and understand more about parish life; snacks provided.

events.title: CTIS Course on Bioethics - information session
events.text: Online information session by Zoom on the CMG-CTIS Certificate in Bioethics. Register at https://www.cmg.org.sg/cmg-ctis-certificate-in-bioethics/ to receive the Zoom link.

events.title: Sec 4/5 Outreach
events.text: For those graduating from secondary school this year: a time of prayer with the Lord and getting to know fellow Sec 4 & 5 students.

events.title: Conversations that Matter
events.text: Fr David Garcia, OP and Nicholas Gabriel Lim on identity, attraction and morality, with practical guidance on listening and responding to your teen while staying rooted in the faith.
